dedale.name: DEDALE: Dataset for Evaluating Detection of APT among Logs and Events
dedale.license: CC BY 4.0; cite the dataset and link https://dedale.inria.fr/ in any use or redistribution.
dedale.provenance: emulated-testbed (about 40 VMs, AD domain breach.local, AURA-generated benign activity, 8-day APT)
dedale.telemetry: Winlogbeat 7.10.2 ECS 1.5.0 NDJSON; archive is a zip (deflate) of 673 hourly .jsonl.bz2 files, 309 non-empty; ~1.8 GB JSON and 650-730k events per busy hour across ~30 Windows clients

files.note: deflate-wrapped bz2 as stored in the zip; attack-start hour

dedale.fetch_command: HTTP Range requests against the archive URL at the offsets in winlogbeat_zip_index.json (local header at offset, then 30+name+extra bytes, then usize bytes), inflate with zlib wbits=-15, then bz2 decompress
dedale.subset_kept: two hourly files (probe). Plan: all 309 non-empty hours, filtered at fetch time to Sysmon 1/3/22, Security, PowerShell channels, per host
dedale.labels: data/external/dedale/labels/dedale_class1_labels.json (native refs host;channel;record_id), generated by scripts/dedale_labels.py from system_logs_labels.zip class-1 files (9,567 events; 84 Sysmon 1, 0 Security). CC BY 4.0: the derived label file may be committed under tests/fixtures/external_labels/ once stable.

probe_2026-09-10.consequence: Security channel present (logon successes only in sampled hours): ATH-006 can run; ATH-005 needs 4625 failures, unconfirmed. No Sysmon 3 network events in either hour: the network table will be empty, ATH-003 and the network specialist are blind on DEDALE unless Zeek conn.log (host-less) is added later. Not coerced: Sysmon 22 DNS queries are not connections.

slices.winlogbeat: data/external/dedale/winlogbeat/D<day>_<date>.jsonl, produced by scripts/dedale_fetch_hours.py (range-fetch per hour, keep Sysmon 1/3, Security 4624/4625/4634/4648/4672, PowerShell 4103/4104); full per-hour class counts in dedale/hour_stats.json so E0 denominators survive filtering

fetched_2026-09-10.note: per-hour class counts in dedale/hour_stats.json are the E0 denominators; the adapter's rows_read on a slice counts kept lines only

results_2026-09-10.D03: 30 ATH-004 findings (lsass.exe started by wininit.exe at boot on each of 30 hosts), 30 singleton cases, 0% triage; reports/m14/dedale_d03.json
results_2026-09-10.D15: same 30 boot findings; 5 labelled process creates resolved, 0 surfaced; case precision 0%; reports/m14/dedale_d15.deterministic.json; LLM arm unavailable (no key)
